title: Open Food Facts — fix shared-head ingredient parsing for sheep's and goat's milk
type: Volunteer / open food-data parser and tests
notes: Alternative current issue, opened 2026-10-07 and updated 2026-10-08. Reporter says 'Pasteurised sheep's and goat's milk' is not split correctly because the parser tries to recognize 'sheep's' without its shared head word 'milk'. Existing parser logic and tests are available. More technical and requires care around broadening 'and' splitting. No comment, branch or PR made; no assignment or acceptance implied. Superseded as our first choice by the ASHA Care community request because that owner explicitly said the reporting section is missing and shared the active project. Source: https://github.com/openfoodfacts/openfoodfacts-server/issues/14853
